scope_policy: Metal fabrication and metal site elements only; base bid only — alternates excluded (list them).

Include: structural & misc. steel, steel deck, grating, handrails/guardrails, chain-link & ornamental fences and gates, bollards, bike racks, trash receptacles, basketball systems, sign structures (signs as allowance if pre-engineered by sign manufacturer).

Exclude unless asked: benches, picnic tables, boulders/bronze, logs, play equipment, light-gauge framing, sheet-metal flashing/gutters, wood fences, field finish painting, concrete foundations other than post/bollard footings, special inspection, bonds, sales tax.
exclusiones_base: Structural steel (05 1200) unless listed in the scope.
Field painting beyond shop primer unless listed; galvanizing only where listed.
Performance and payment bonds; Washington State sales tax (resale to GC).
